title: Streamlining stereo differentiable rendering for marker-free real-time tracking of surgical robots
summary: Purpose: Marker-based tracking of surgical robots is occlusion-prone in cluttered operating rooms. We evaluate stereo differentiable rendering for marker-free, real-time robot pose tracking, potentially improving safety, reducing setup time, and enabling multi-robot interaction. Methods: We extend the markerless pose estimation framework roboreg to online dynamic tracking via (i) sequential optimisation that propagates pose estimates across frames with motion-adaptive hyperparameter tuning, and (ii) CUDA stream parallelisation of segmentation and optimisation, combined with CUDA-graph accelerated segmentation. We evaluate on 38 unobstructed and 5 occluded displacement sequences with static start/end ground-truth calibrations and dynamic marker-based reference tracking. Results: We achieve real-time 1080p tracking at 30 fps (up from 14 fps for vanilla roboreg), matching the camera frame rate. Accuracy reaches 1.7 cm / 0.6 deg against static ground truth and 1.2 cm mean 3D error over 27,460 frames against the marker-based reference (1.53 cm over 1,242 occluded frames). Our method outperforms FoundationPose by 11% in dynamic estimation (63% under occlusion) and 250% in static estimation, with 6x faster inference. Conclusions: Stereo differentiable rendering enables real-time, high-resolution marker-free surgical robot tracking, on par with marker-based approaches and surpassing foundation-model baselines.
tldr: This paper extends a markerless pose estimation framework for surgical robots to achieve real-time, high-resolution tracking using stereo differentiable rendering, outperforming marker-based methods and foundation models at 30 fps with improved accuracy.
tldr_zh: 本文通过立体可微渲染技术，将无标记姿态估计框架扩展到手术机器人的实时高分辨率跟踪，以30 fps的速度实现优于有标记方法和基础模型的精度。
summary_zh:
摘要  
目的：在杂乱的手术室环境中，基于标记的外科机器人追踪容易受到遮挡影响。本文评估了立体可微分渲染在无标记、实时机器人位姿追踪中的性能，有望提升安全性、减少设置时间，并支持多机器人交互。  
方法：我们基于无标记位姿估计框架 roboreg 扩展至在线动态追踪，采用以下两项改进：(i) 顺序优化——通过运动自适应超参数调整跨帧传播位姿估计值；(ii) CUDA 流并行化处理分割与优化，并结合 CUDA 图加速分割。我们在 38 个无遮挡序列和 5 个遮挡位移序列上进行评估，采用静态起点/终点真实值标定以及基于标记的动态参考追踪。  
结果：我们实现了 30 帧/秒（较原版 roboreg 的 14 帧/秒提升）的实时 1080p 追踪，与相机帧率一致。静态真实值对比下的精度达到 1.7 cm / 0.6°；在 27,460 帧上与基于标记的参考对比，平均 3D 误差为 1.2 cm（其中 1,242 帧遮挡场景下为 1.53 cm）。我们的方法在动态估计中优于 FoundationPose 11%（遮挡场景下为 63%），在静态估计中优于 250%，且推理速度提升 6 倍。  
结论：立体可微分渲染实现了实时、高分辨率、无标记的外科机器人追踪，性能与基于标记的方法相当，并超越了基础模型基线。

title: ExtraGS: Enhancing Endoscopic View Extrapolation via Diffusion-Guided 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: Robot-assisted minimally invasive surgery (MIS) critically depends on reliable endoscopic perception for navigation and safety. However, conventional endoscopes provide only a limited field of view, leaving large portions of the surrounding anatomy unobserved. Recent neural rendering approaches, such as Neural Radiance Fields and 3D Gaussian Splatting, enable novel view synthesis from endoscopic videos, but their reliance on sparse observations often leads to severe artifacts when extrapolating beyond the training trajectory. In this work, we propose ExtraGS, a framework for enhancing endoscopic view extrapolation through diffusion-guided 3D Gaussian Splatting. Starting from an initial reconstruction, we introduce an uncertainty-guided virtual camera sampling strategy to actively explore blind spots and maximize information gain. The rendered views from these sampled locations are refined using a diffusion model to recover plausible anatomical structures, producing pseudo-observations that guide further optimization. To prevent the generated content from degrading reliable regions, we adopt a confidence-weighted fine-tuning strategy when incorporating these pseudo-observations. Extensive experiments on multiple public endoscopic datasets demonstrate that ExtraGS significantly reduces extrapolation artifacts and achieves state-of-the-art performance in endoscopic novel view synthesis.
tldr: ExtraGS enhances endoscopic view extrapolation by combining 3D Gaussian Splatting with diffusion model refinement, using uncertainty-guided virtual camera sampling and confidence-weighted fine-tuning to reduce artifacts in unseen regions.
tldr_zh: ExtraGS通过结合3D高斯泼溅与扩散模型精化，利用不确定性引导的虚拟相机采样和置信度加权微调，减少内窥镜视野外推中的伪影。
summary_zh: 机器人辅助微创手术（MIS）的导航与安全性高度依赖于可靠的內镜感知。然而，传统内窥镜仅提供有限的视野，导致周围解剖结构的大部分区域未被观测。近期神经渲染方法（如神经辐射场和3D高斯泼溅）可从内窥镜视频中合成新视角，但这类方法依赖于稀疏观测，在泛化至训练轨迹以外的视角时往往产生严重伪影。本文提出ExtraGS——一种通过扩散引导的3D高斯泼溅增强内窥镜视角外推的框架。从初始重建出发，我们引入不确定性引导的虚拟相机采样策略，以主动探索盲区并最大化信息增益。利用扩散模型对采样位置的渲染视图进行优化，以恢复合理的解剖结构，生成引导进一步优化的伪观测。为防止生成内容退化可靠区域，我们在融入这些伪观测时采用置信度加权微调策略。在多个公开内窥镜数据集上的大量实验表明，ExtraGS显著减少了外推伪影，并在内窥镜新视角合成中实现最先进性能。

title: MAGE: Color-Invariant and Spatial Knowledge Distillation for Gastric Neoplasm Classification
summary: Accurate differentiation between gastric adenoma and carcinoma during endoscopy is critical for clinical decision-making. Yet, this task is highly challenging due to high inter-class similarity and ambiguous boundaries between the two classes. Existing ROI-based classification methods often suffer from detection/segmentation error propagation and loss of surrounding global context. In contrast, full-image classification lacks the necessary spatial focus. Furthermore, we observe that deep neural networks gravitate towards domain-specific texture biases(e.g. bleeding, lighting artifacts), often causing models to predict based on spurious correlations instead of intrinsic morphological features. To address these limitations, we propose a novel framework, Masked Achromatic Guidance Expert (MAGE). During training, we introduce an auxiliary local expert branch trained on masked achromatic views of the neoplasm. By suppressing background context and color, this branch is forced to learn highly discriminative, purely structural features. We then employ a dual-objective distillation strategy, transferring both classification logits and spatial attention maps to provide implicit spatial supervision to the main branch that receives full WLI as input. This dual-objective distillation forces the model to ground its predictions in morphology rather than relying on shortcuts, while still retaining clinically relevant color cues. At inference time, our deployable model operates on images without annotated masks, ensuring real-time deployability . Extensive experiments on a clinical gastric endoscopy dataset show that our method significantly outperforms existing detection-based methodologies (e.g. YOLO) and classification-based methodologies (e.g. Swin-Transformer), providing not only superior classification performance but also interpretable attention maps for clinical reliability.
tldr: A framework using masked achromatic views and dual-objective distillation to improve gastric neoplasm classification from endoscopy images, achieving better performance and interpretability.
tldr_zh: 一个利用掩膜消色视图和双目标蒸馏的框架，用于改善内窥镜图像中胃肿瘤的分类，实现更优性能和可解释性。
summary_zh: 在内镜检查中准确区分胃腺瘤与胃癌对于临床决策至关重要。然而，由于两类病变间的高度类间相似性和模糊的边界，这一任务极具挑战性。现有的基于感兴趣区域（ROI）的分类方法常面临检测/分割误差传播及周围全局上下文丢失的问题。相比之下，全图像分类缺乏必要的空间聚焦。此外，我们观察到深度神经网络倾向于关注特定领域的纹理偏差（如出血、光照伪影），常导致模型基于虚假相关性而非内在形态特征进行预测。为解决这些局限，我们提出了一种新颖框架——掩膜消色引导专家（MAGE）。在训练阶段，我们引入一个辅助局部专家分支，该分支在肿瘤的掩膜消色视图上进行训练。通过抑制背景上下文和颜色，该分支被迫学习高度判别性的纯结构特征。随后，我们采用双目标蒸馏策略，同时转移分类逻辑值和空间注意力图，为接收全白光内镜（WLI）输入的主分支提供隐式空间监督。这种双目标蒸馏迫使模型基于形态学而非捷径进行预测，同时保留临床相关的颜色线索。在推理时，我们的可部署模型直接处理无标注掩膜的图像，确保实时部署能力。在临床胃镜数据集上的大量实验表明，我们的方法显著优于现有基于检测的方法（如YOLO）和基于分类的方法（如Swin-Transformer），不仅提供了卓越的分类性能，还为临床可靠性提供了可解释的注意力图。

title: Seeing Globally, Refining Locally: Global Visual Guidance and Local Ultrasound Cues for Robust Freehand 3-D Ultrasound Reconstruction
summary: Freehand 3-D ultrasound (US) imaging has attracted increasing attention owing to its intuitive volumetric visualization, ease of use, and low cost. However, accurate 3-D reconstruction critically depends on stable probe pose estimation, yet existing trackerless methods remain susceptible to accumulated pose errors, particularly over long scanning trajectories. To address this limitation, we propose a global-to-local pose estimation framework that exploits external camera observations for globally stable localization and B-mode US images for anatomy-aware local refinement. Specifically, the framework comprises a dual-camera branch that performs contextual feature aggregation across camera views and temporal observations to estimate a globally consistent probe trajectory, and a B-mode branch that performs anatomical feature aggregation from sequential US images to capture tissue-dependent local motion cues. A cross-modal fusion module subsequently integrates the contextual camera features and anatomical US features to predict pose residuals and refine the camera-derived estimates in the transformation space. Furthermore, a multi-scale pose loss constrains relative motion over multiple temporal horizons to suppress accumulated drift during extended scans. The proposed framework is validated on phantom and in vivo datasets. On two in-house datasets (FUSION-J and FUSION-L) collected using different machines, the proposed US + Dual-Cam model reduces average trajectory drift to 1.67 mm and 1.29 mm, representing improvement of 16.50% and 27.12%, respectively, over a strong dual-camera baseline, while substantially outperforming US-only pose estimation (>13 mm drift). In in vivo forearm arteries reconstruction, it achieves Hausdorff distances of 1.58 mm, demonstrating the effectiveness of the proposed method on real clinical scenarios.
tldr: A global-to-local pose estimation framework for freehand 3D ultrasound reconstruction that combines external camera observations for global stability and B-mode ultrasound images for local refinement, achieving substantial drift reduction on phantom and in vivo datasets.
tldr_zh: 提出一种全局到局部位姿估计框架，用于自由手3D超声重建，结合外部相机观测实现全局稳定性和B模式超声图像实现局部细化，在体模和体内数据集上显著减少了漂移。
summary_zh: 自由手三维超声成像因其直观的容积可视化、易用性和低成本而受到越来越多的关注。然而，精确的三维重建关键依赖于稳定的探头位姿估计，现有无跟踪器方法仍易受累积位姿误差的影响，尤其是在长扫描轨迹中。为解决此问题，我们提出了一种全局到局部的位姿估计框架，该框架利用外部相机观测实现全局稳定的定位，并利用B模式超声图像实现解剖感知的局部细化。具体而言，该框架包含一个双目摄像头分支，通过跨相机视角和时间观测进行上下文特征聚合，以估计全局一致的探头轨迹；以及一个B模式分支，从连续超声图像中聚合解剖特征，以捕捉组织依赖的局部运动线索。随后，一个跨模态融合模块整合上下文相机特征和解剖超声特征，在变换空间中预测位姿残差并细化相机估计结果。此外，多尺度位姿损失在多个时间跨度上约束相对运动，以抑制长时间扫描中的累积漂移。所提框架在体模和活体数据集上进行了验证。在使用不同设备采集的两个内部数据集（FUSION-J和FUSION-L）上，所提出的超声+双目摄像头模型将平均轨迹漂移降低至1.67 mm和1.29 mm，相较于强双摄像头基线分别提升了16.50%和27.12%，同时显著优于仅使用超声的位姿估计（漂移>13 mm）。在活体前臂动脉重建中，该方法实现了1.58 mm的豪斯多夫距离，证明了所提方法在真实临床场景中的有效性。

title: Evidence-Grounded AI for Musculoskeletal Care
summary: Musculoskeletal diseases are among the leading causes of disability worldwide and create the greatest global need for rehabilitation. Because recovery, remodelling and degeneration often unfold over months to years, musculoskeletal care requires longitudinal management that repeatedly integrates evolving patient evidence, external medical knowledge and stage-specific functional goals. In routine practice, this evidence is fragmented across visits, departments and hospital systems, limiting individualized, evidence-based care. Here we report OrthoPilot, a clinical artificial intelligence system powered by a large language model that integrates hospital data streams with authoritative external knowledge for continuous musculoskeletal management. OrthoPilot autonomously retrieves real-time imaging, laboratory, pathology and order data and converts evolving patient states into evidence-based decisions from admission diagnosis to rehabilitation planning. We established a specialist-validated benchmark from real-world electronic health records spanning 1,000 disease codes. In a reader study across the complete care pathway, OrthoPilot was compared with 81 orthopaedic physicians and surpassed experts with 25 years of experience in diagnostic reasoning, clinical decision-making and management planning. It also outperformed all evaluated intelligent systems across 60 external clinical centres. In a prospective study of 1,870 complex cases, OrthoPilot increased full-chain management success by 10.6%. During an 8-month randomised deployment involving 8,240 inpatients, it increased cumulative cases per bed by 9.7% and improved patient-reported access to health information. These results move clinical AI from predicting isolated events toward executing longitudinal management across complete musculoskeletal care pathways.
tldr: OrthoPilot is an LLM-powered clinical AI system that integrates hospital data with external knowledge to manage musculoskeletal care longitudinally, outperforming experienced physicians and increasing management success by 10.6% in prospective studies.
tldr_zh: OrthoPilot 是一个基于大语言模型的临床AI系统，整合医院数据与外部知识对肌肉骨骼疾病进行纵向管理，在研究中超越资深医生，并将全链路管理成功率提升10.6%。
summary_zh: 肌肉骨骼疾病是全球范围内致残的主要原因之一，也是全球康复需求的最大来源。由于恢复、重塑和退变过程通常持续数月乃至数年，肌肉骨骼诊疗需要纵向管理，反复整合不断变化的患者证据、外部医学知识以及特定阶段的康复目标。在常规实践中，这些证据分散在不同就诊、科室和医院系统之间，限制了个性化、循证医学的实施。本文报告了OrthoPilot——一种基于大语言模型的临床人工智能系统，它整合医院数据流与权威外部知识，实现持续的肌肉骨骼管理。OrthoPilot可自主检索实时影像、实验室、病理和医嘱数据，将从入院诊断到康复规划的动态患者状态转化为循证决策。我们基于覆盖1000种疾病编码的真实世界电子健康记录，构建了一个经专科医生验证的基准数据集。在一项覆盖完整诊疗路径的读者研究中，将OrthoPilot与81名骨科医师进行比较，其在诊断推理、临床决策和管理规划方面超越了具有25年经验的专家。在60个外部临床中心，它同样优于所有接受评估的智能系统。在一项涉及1870例复杂病例的前瞻性研究中，OrthoPilot使全链条管理成功率提升10.6%。在为期8个月、涉及8240名住院患者的随机部署中，它使每床位累计病例数提升9.7%，并改善了患者报告的健康信息获取能力。这些结果将临床人工智能从预测孤立事件推向在完整肌肉骨骼诊疗路径中执行纵向管理。

title: Agentic systems for breast cancer treatment recommendations
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly being explored for clinical decision support, but their reliability in complex oncology treatment planning remains unclear. We evaluated agentic LLM systems for breast cancer treatment recommendation generation using 72 real clinical cases across stages I to IV and 1,147 case-specific rubrics generated through Asymmetric Information Rubric Generation (AIRG), in which the rubric generator had access to real clinical decisions unavailable to the evaluated models. Seven pipelines were compared, including single-LLM baselines, tool-augmented systems, and multi-agent architectures with fact checking and autonomous subagent spawning. The best-performing configuration, Claude Opus 4.8 with the D&C+SA pipeline, achieved a global score of 0.594 $\pm$ 0.025. Tool use and increased agent autonomy had mixed effects, improving performance in some settings but degrading it in others. Performance varied by clinical domain and disease stage, and oncologist-led error analysis revealed persistent clinically relevant failures, including incorrect or missing recommendations, flawed justifications, citation errors, outdated claims, and overconfidence. These findings suggest that agentic LLM systems can generate clinically relevant breast cancer recommendations, but remain insufficient for unsupervised clinical use.
tldr: Evaluates agentic LLM systems for breast cancer treatment recommendations using 72 real clinical cases and a novel rubric generation method (AIRG), finding that the best pipeline achieves a global score of 0.594 but remains unreliable for unsupervised clinical use due to persistent errors.
tldr_zh: 评估了基于智能体的大语言模型系统在乳腺癌治疗推荐中的应用，使用72个真实临床案例和一种新的评分生成方法（AIRG），发现最佳管线得分为0.594，但由于持续存在的错误，仍不适合无监督的临床使用。
summary_zh: 大语言模型（LLMs）在临床决策支持中的应用日益受到关注，但其在复杂肿瘤治疗规划中的可靠性尚不明确。我们利用72例涵盖I至IV期的真实临床病例，以及通过非对称信息评分标准生成（AIRG）方法构建的1147项病例特异性评分标准，对基于智能体的大语言模型系统在乳腺癌治疗推荐生成中的表现进行了评估。其中，评分标准生成者可获取被评估模型无法获得的真实临床决策。研究比较了七种管道，包括单大语言模型基线、工具增强系统，以及具备事实核查与自主子智能体生成功能的多智能体架构。性能最佳的配置——采用D&C+SA管道的Claude Opus 4.8——实现了0.594 ± 0.025的全局得分。工具使用与智能体自主性提升产生了混合效应：在某些场景下改善性能，但在其他场景下则导致性能下降。性能因临床领域和疾病分期而异，而肿瘤学家主导的误差分析揭示了持续存在的临床相关缺陷，包括推荐内容错误或遗漏、论证依据有缺陷、引用错误、过时断言以及过度自信。这些发现表明，基于智能体的大语言模型系统能够生成具有临床相关性的乳腺癌治疗推荐，但仍不足以用于无监督的临床实践。

title: Medical Image Segmentation based on Deep Active Contour and Mean Curvature Loss Function
summary: Medical image segmentation is a crucial task in the field of clinical analysis and applications. Though deep learning techniques recently play a crucial role in several scenarios, the training at the individual pixel level leads to a lack of geometric prior information. Scholars proposed to integrate the Chan-Vese model into the loss function for training which can take into account the region and length of the region inside and outside the segmentation process and then improve the performance in medical image segmentation. However, these methods still lack an effective characterization of the segmented region. To overcome this problem, we introduce the mean curvature as a geometric natural constraint and propose a Deep Active Contour and Mean Curvature (DACMC) loss function where the convolution kernel is used to approximate the mean curvature to save computational cost. We have validated the performance of our method on the liver and spleen dataset. Our proposed method demonstrates new state-of-the-art performance on several segmentation datasets.
tldr: This paper proposes a novel loss function incorporating mean curvature as a geometric constraint for deep active contour-based medical image segmentation, achieving state-of-the-art results on liver and spleen datasets.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种结合平均曲率作为几何约束的深度主动轮廓损失函数，用于医学图像分割，在肝脏和脾脏数据集上取得了最新最优结果。
summary_zh: 医学图像分割是临床分析及应用领域中的一项关键任务。尽管深度学习技术近期在多种场景中发挥了重要作用，但基于单个像素级别的训练导致其缺乏几何先验信息。学者们提出将Chan-Vese模型融入损失函数进行训练，从而在分割过程中兼顾区域内部与外部的面积及长度，进而提升医学图像分割的性能。然而，这些方法仍缺乏对分割区域的有效表征。为解决这一问题，我们引入平均曲率作为几何自然约束，并提出一种深度主动轮廓与平均曲率（DACMC）损失函数，其中利用卷积核近似计算平均曲率以节省计算成本。我们在肝脏和脾脏数据集上验证了该方法的性能。我们的方法在多个分割数据集上展现了新的最优性能。

title: UniMedSeg: Unified In-Context Learning for Multi-Paradigm 2D/3D Medical Image Segmentation
summary: Medical image segmentation foundation models are expected to generalize across diverse clinical scenarios, yet existing universal methods remain fragmented by prompt paradigms and spatial dimensions. Visual in-context learning, interactive segmentation, and language-guided segmentation are typically handled by paradigm-specific models, while 2D and 3D images are also modeled separately. Such isolation prevents heterogeneous annotations and data from being jointly absorbed by a single scalable model and limits cross-paradigm knowledge transfer. To address this bottleneck, we propose UniMedSeg, a Transformer-centric universal segmentation framework that maps visual examples, geometric interactions, language instructions, and 2D/3D images into a shared sequence space, enabling heterogeneous medical supervision to be jointly learned through a unified in-context interface without prompt- or dimension-specific branches. To overcome the long-sequence memory bottleneck caused by visual contexts, we introduce Decoupled Split Attention, which reduces attention complexity to linear while preserving hardware-friendly computation and focused context-target interaction. Extensively trained and evaluated on a large corpus curated from 27 public datasets, UniMedSeg achieves state-of-the-art performance across visual in-context, interactive, and language-guided segmentation without task-specific fine-tuning, demonstrating strong generalization on diverse held-out tasks. The code and model weights are publicly available at https://github.com/Lii1228/UniMedSeg
tldr: UniMedSeg is a unified Transformer-based framework that handles visual in-context, interactive, and language-guided segmentation for both 2D and 3D medical images using a shared sequence space and Decoupled Split Attention, achieving state-of-the-art performance without task-specific fine-tuning.
tldr_zh: UniMedSeg是一个统一的基于Transformer的框架，通过共享序列空间和解耦拆分注意力机制，处理视觉上下文、交互式、语言引导的2D/3D医学图像分割，无需任务特定微调即可达到最先进性能。
summary_zh: 医学图像分割基础模型预期能够泛化至多样的临床场景，然而现有的通用方法仍受提示范式与空间维度的碎片化制约。视觉上下文学习、交互式分割与语言引导分割通常由特定范式的模型处理，而2D与3D图像也被分别建模。这种隔离导致异构标注与数据无法被单一可扩展模型联合吸收，并限制了跨范式的知识迁移。为突破这一瓶颈，我们提出UniMedSeg——一个以Transformer为核心的通用分割框架，将视觉示例、几何交互、语言指令以及2D/3D图像映射至共享的序列空间，使得异构的医学监督信号能够通过统一的上下文接口被联合学习，无需针对提示或维度的分支。为克服视觉上下文带来的长序列内存瓶颈，我们引入解耦分离注意力机制，将注意力复杂度降至线性，同时保持硬件友好的计算与聚焦的上下文-目标交互。基于从27个公开数据集中整理的大规模语料库进行充分训练与评估，UniMedSeg在视觉上下文、交互式与语言引导分割任务上均达到最先进性能，无需任务特定的微调，并在多种留出任务上展现出强大的泛化能力。代码与模型权重已在https://github.com/Lii1228/UniMedSeg 公开。

title: Virtual Chromoendscopy with Tunable Visibility Enhancement
summary: Chromoendoscopy (CE) is a common clinical practice that sprays indigo carmine blue dye onto the gastric surface to improve the visibility of gastric lesions, such as an early cancer. While CE is effective in detecting the lesions, preparing and spraying the dye needs additional cost and time, which is undesirable both for patients and medical practitioners. To overcome this issue, virtual chromoendoscopy (V-CE) was recently proposed, which applies a learned image translation model to virtually generate a CE image from a standard endoscopy (SE) image. In this paper, we propose virtual enhanced chromoendoscopy (V-ECE) that combines V-CE with image enhancement techniques to further improve the visibility of gastric lesions. Because a desired enhancement level depends on the inspected lesion and the practitioner's preference, we introduce a novel image translation model that can generate V-ECE images using an enhancement level tunable by a user. Experimental results demonstrate that our proposed model can plausibly generate V-ECE images with various enhancement levels using a unified model.
tldr: The paper proposes Virtual Enhanced Chromoendoscopy (V-ECE), a novel image translation model that generates virtual chromoendoscopy images with user-tunable enhancement levels from standard endoscopy images, aiming to improve visibility of gastric lesions without the cost and time of dye spraying.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出虚拟增强色素内镜（V-ECE），一种新颖的图像翻译模型，可从标准内镜图像生成具有用户可调增强水平的虚拟色素内镜图像，旨在提高胃部病变的可见性，同时避免染料喷洒的成本和时间。
summary_zh: 色素内镜（CE）是一种临床常用技术，通过将靛胭脂蓝染料喷洒于胃黏膜表面，以提升胃部病变（如早期癌症）的可视性。尽管CE能有效检出病变，但染料的配制与喷洒过程需额外的时间与成本，这对患者和医务人员而言均不理想。为克服这一问题，近期提出了虚拟色素内镜（V-CE）技术，该技术应用经过学习的图像转换模型，从标准内镜（SE）图像虚拟生成CE图像。本文提出虚拟增强色素内镜（V-ECE），将V-CE与图像增强技术相结合，以进一步提升胃部病变的可视性。由于理想的增强程度取决于所检查的病变及操作者的偏好，我们引入一种新型图像转换模型，可生成由用户调节增强程度的V-ECE图像。实验结果表明，所提模型能够使用统一模型合理生成具有多种增强程度的V-ECE图像。

title: From Many to Meaningful: Feature-Guided Zero-Shot Chronic Kidney Disease Screening Using Large Language Models
summary: Early screening of chronic kidney disease (CKD) is essential for preventing irreversible progression; however, many machine learning (ML)-based screening methods remain difficult to deploy in community and resource-limited screening settings due to their reliance on large labeled datasets, resource-intensive pathology tests, or high-dimensional clinical features, and limited robustness to population and distributional shifts. This study examines the feasibility of using large language models (LLMs) for early-stage CKD screening in a zero-shot setting, without dataset-specific training. We propose a feature-guided zero-shot framework that evaluates LLM performance using a selected set of clinically meaningful, readily available community-based features, rather than exhaustive clinical inputs. Feature selection was guided by ML-based analysis to identify a compact, clinically relevant subset of variables. Tabular patient records were subsequently serialized into text using standardized prompt templates to enable zero-shot inference. The zero-shot performance of four LLMs (LLaMA-3, Qwen-3, Mistral, and GPT-4o-mini) was evaluated using both the full feature set and the selected subset. Generalizability was assessed across three heterogeneous CKD datasets spanning three countries. Across models and datasets, the selected feature set yielded consistent and statistically significant improvements in balanced accuracy and probability estimates, achieving performance levels suitable for screening purposes. These findings suggest that LLMs can support clinically meaningful, training-free CKD screening using minimal community-accessible patient features, offering a practical complement to conventional ML methods in real-world screening contexts.
tldr: This paper proposes a feature-guided zero-shot framework using large language models (LLMs) for early chronic kidney disease (CKD) screening with minimal community-accessible features, achieving consistent performance improvements across multiple datasets without training.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于大语言模型（LLM）的特征引导零样本框架，利用少量社区可获取的特征进行早期慢性肾病（CKD）筛查，在多个数据集上无需训练即可实现一致的性能提升。
summary_zh: 摘要：慢性肾脏病（CKD）的早期筛查对于防止不可逆的病情进展至关重要；然而，许多基于机器学习（ML）的筛查方法由于依赖大规模标注数据集、资源密集型的病理检测或高维临床特征，且对人群和分布变化的鲁棒性有限，仍难以在社区和资源有限的筛查环境中部署。本研究探讨了在无需数据集特定训练的情况下，利用大语言模型（LLMs）进行零样本早期CKD筛查的可行性。我们提出了一种特征引导的零样本框架，该框架使用一组经过筛选的、临床意义明确且易于获取的社区特征（而非全面的临床输入）来评估LLM的性能。特征选择基于机器学习分析，以确定一组简洁且临床相关的变量子集。随后，通过标准化提示模板将表格形式的患者记录序列化为文本，以实现零样本推理。使用完整特征集和所选特征子集对四种LLM（LLaMA-3、Qwen-3、Mistral和GPT-4o-mini）的零样本性能进行了评估。跨三个国家三个异质性CKD数据集评估了其泛化能力。在各模型和数据集上，所选特征集在平衡准确率和概率估计方面均产生了一致且统计学显著的改进，达到了适合筛查目的的性能水平。这些发现表明，LLM能够利用最少的社区可获取患者特征，支持无需训练的临床有意义的CKD筛查，为实际筛查场景中传统机器学习方法提供了实用的补充。

title: DermDepth: Toward Monocular Metric Scale 3D Reconstruction Models for Dermatology
summary: Dermatological practice routinely involves measuring and tracking lesion size, morphology and texture, as critical components of wound or skin cancer screening, monitoring and diagnosis. To accomplish this task, practitioners often image the skin surface with commonly available off-the-shelf camera sensors. This has led to an overwhelming research focus on 2D methods while these objectives naturally benefit from 3D information. In this paper, we demonstrate that dense monocular 3D reconstructions, metric scale measurements and rich surface normal texture estimates are achievable for both dermoscopic and macroscopic cases without the need for additional hardware or multiple captures. We present DermDepth, the first single-view metric scale 3D model for the dermatological domain and D-Synth, the first synthetic dermoscopic dataset with pixel-perfect 3D information. Our experiments show training DermDepth on D-Synth corrects metric scale error from over 16x to under 1.1x for real dermoscopic data, while preserving geometric quality and increasing texture richness. Fine-tuning on a small amount of real clinical samples generalizes our method across three real-world benchmarks spanning the few mm to hundred cm range, diverse skin-tones, chronic wound cases and produces measurements broadly consistent with disease size reported in medical literature. All code, data and models are available at https://github.com/hectorcarrion/dermdepth.
tldr: DermDepth is the first monocular metric-scale 3D reconstruction model for dermatology, using a synthetic dataset D-Synth to correct scale errors and achieve accurate lesion measurements without additional hardware.
tldr_zh: DermDepth 是首个用于皮肤科的单目度量尺度三维重建模型，利用合成数据集 D-Synth 校正尺度误差，无需额外硬件即可实现精确的病灶测量。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
皮肤科临床工作通常涉及测量和追踪病灶的大小、形态及纹理，这是伤口或皮肤癌筛查、监测与诊断的关键环节。为完成此任务，临床医生常使用市售的普通相机传感器对皮肤表面进行成像。这导致研究过度聚焦于二维方法，而事实上这些目标自然能从三维信息中获益。本文证明，对于皮肤镜及宏观病例，无需额外硬件或多重拍摄即可实现稠密单目三维重建、公制尺度测量及丰富的表面法向纹理估计。我们提出了DermDepth——首个面向皮肤科领域的单视图公制尺度三维模型，以及D-Synth——首个包含像素级完美三维信息的合成皮肤镜数据集。实验表明，在D-Synth上训练DermDepth，可将真实皮肤镜数据的公制尺度误差从超过16倍纠正至低于1.1倍，同时保持几何质量并提升纹理丰富度。通过在少量真实临床样本上进行微调，我们的方法可泛化至三个覆盖毫米至百米跨度、多种肤色及慢性伤口病例的真实世界基准测试，其测量结果与医学文献中报道的病灶尺寸基本一致。所有代码、数据和模型均可在 https://github.com/hectorcarrion/dermdepth 获取。

title: Decouple and Reason: Anatomically Guided Two-Stage Voxel-Level Grounding of Free-Text Findings in 3D Chest CT
summary: Automatic voxel-level grounding of free-text findings in 3D chest Computed Tomography (CT) is critical for clinical interpretability. However, this task remains highly challenging due to the intricate spatial complexity of large 3D volumes and the heterogeneity of free-text findings. Existing end-to-end approaches often struggle to simultaneously learn the localized feature representations required for accurate 3D segmentation and the complex semantic understanding needed for text alignment, leading to suboptimal grounding performance. To overcome this fundamental limitation, we propose a novel decoupled framework that disentangles the problem into two specialized stages: (1) class-agnostic lesion segmentation and (2) text-volume reasoning. This structural separation allows the model to first extract candidate sub-volumes by localizing potential abnormalities. Subsequently, intensive cross-modal reasoning is performed to align these localized sub-volumes with free-text medical findings. To resolve the spatial ambiguities inherent in local regions, the reasoning module is augmented with explicit anatomical guidance, utilizing relative spatial coordinates and lung lobe priors. Evaluated on the ReXGroundingCT benchmark, our method achieves state-of-the-art performance in overall grounding quality on the official leaderboard. These results demonstrate that decoupling detection from reasoning is a highly effective paradigm for handling the complexity of 3D medical visual grounding. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/khuhm/DAGG.
tldr: Proposes a two-stage decoupled framework for voxel-level grounding of free-text findings in 3D chest CT, separating class-agnostic lesion segmentation from text-volume reasoning with anatomical guidance, achieving state-of-the-art on the ReXGroundingCT benchmark.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种两阶段解耦框架，用于3D胸部CT中自由文本发现的体素级定位，将类别无关的病变分割与文本-体积推理分离，并加入解剖引导，在ReXGroundingCT基准上达到最优性能。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
在三维胸部计算机断层扫描（CT）中，对自由文本发现进行自动体素级定位对于临床可解释性至关重要。然而，由于三维大体积数据的复杂空间结构以及自由文本发现的异质性，该任务仍极具挑战性。现有端到端方法往往难以同时学习精确三维分割所需的局部化特征表示和文本对齐所需的复杂语义理解，导致定位性能欠佳。为克服这一根本性局限，我们提出了一种新颖的解耦框架，将问题分解为两个专门阶段：（1）类别无关的病变分割和（2）文本-体积推理。这种结构分离使模型能够首先通过定位潜在异常来提取候选子体积。随后，执行密集的跨模态推理以将这些局部子体积与自由文本医学发现对齐。为解决局部区域固有的空间模糊性，推理模块通过显式解剖学引导进行增强，利用相对空间坐标和肺叶先验知识。在ReXGroundingCT基准上的评估表明，我们的方法在官方排行榜上的整体定位质量达到了最先进水平。这些结果证明，将检测与推理解耦是处理三维医学视觉定位复杂性的高效范式。我们的代码已公开在https://github.com/khuhm/DAGG。
